theorems.statement: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (m : ℕ) (D P Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R), IsUnit P → IsUnit Q → Nonempty (((Fin m → R) ⧸ LinearMap.range (Matrix.mulVecLin D)) ≃ₗ[R] ((Fin m → R) ⧸ LinearMap.range (Matrix.mulVecLin (P * D * Q))))
theorems.natural_summary: The unit matrices P and Q induce linear automorphisms. Surjectivity of Q gives image(PDQ) = image(PD) = P(image(D)). The automorphism P therefore descends to the required quotient linear equivalence, with inverse induced by P⁻¹. This matches the supplied prose and also covers m = 0 and the zero ring.
